title: Globex Logistics QBR

transcript.speaker: omar@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Thanks for joining, Dana. Agenda: fleet health, Atlas status, and renewal.

transcript.speaker: omar@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Fleet health first. 120 robots, 99.1 percent uptime last quarter. You were spared most of the firmware 2.8 Wi-Fi issue since you're still on 2.7 at two sites.

transcript.speaker: dana.whitfield@globexlogistics.com
transcript.text: Yes, and we'll stay on 2.7 until 2.8.1 is out. Our ops team noticed what happened at other sites.

transcript.speaker: sam@northwind.dev
transcript.text: On Atlas, GA is October 14. Fleet view, scheduling, staged OTA are all ready. Your team's feedback on the staged rollout UI was a big help.

transcript.speaker: dana.whitfield@globexlogistics.com
transcript.text: That's great, but I'll be direct. Without SAML SSO, our security team won't approve it. We can't roll it out to any of the 120 robots. Where is SSO?

transcript.speaker: devon@northwind.dev
transcript.text: SSO is built and works. The remaining issue is on KeyGate's side. Their metadata endpoint sometimes serves an outdated signing cert during rotation, so logins fail intermittently. They've committed to a fix on October 9.

transcript.speaker: dana.whitfield@globexlogistics.com
transcript.text: That was going to be September before. I need to go to our CISO with something in writing. Dates, the dependency, and what happens if KeyGate misses.

transcript.speaker: lena@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Completely fair. That's on me, and it's late. I'll get it to you.

transcript.speaker: dana.whitfield@globexlogistics.com
transcript.text: I asked for it on the 26th. When?

transcript.speaker: lena@northwind.dev
transcript.text: By end of this week. I want it to include our fallback option, which we're scoping right now.

transcript.speaker: devon@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Fallback would be direct OIDC with your IdP. Jordan, our eng manager, has an estimate due Friday.

transcript.speaker: dana.whitfield@globexlogistics.com
transcript.text: OIDC works for us in principle. Our IdP supports it. But I need to know it's real before I plan around it.

transcript.speaker: omar@northwind.dev
transcript.text: On renewal, your contract renews November 30. We'd like to start the paperwork mid-October.

transcript.speaker: dana.whitfield@globexlogistics.com
transcript.text: Procurement wants to see Atlas live with SSO before they sign a renewal that includes the Enterprise tier. I'm not threatening anything, I'm telling you what my procurement team will ask.

transcript.speaker: lena@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Understood. We could also separate the R2 lease renewal from the Atlas Enterprise add-on if that makes procurement easier.

transcript.speaker: dana.whitfield@globexlogistics.com
transcript.text: Possibly. Put that in the written document too.

transcript.speaker: omar@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Will do. Let's schedule a check-in for October 15, day after GA.

transcript.speaker: dana.whitfield@globexlogistics.com
transcript.text: Fine. Thanks, everyone. I do like the product, for what it's worth.

summary: Quarterly business review with Globex Logistics (Dana Whitfield). Fleet uptime 99.1% across 120 robots; Globex is holding on firmware 2.7 until 2.8.1. Sam confirmed Atlas GA 2026-10-14. Dana reiterated that Globex cannot roll out Atlas without SAML SSO and that procurement wants Atlas live with SSO before signing the 2026-11-30 renewal. Devon explained the KeyGate signing-cert dependency (fix ETA 2026-10-09). Dana again asked for the written SSO timeline she first requested on 2026-09-26; Lena committed to send it this week, including the OIDC fallback and an option to separate the lease renewal from the Atlas Enterprise add-on.
decisions: Hold a Globex follow-up check-in on 2026-10-15.

action_items.text: Send Globex the written SSO timeline including OIDC fallback and renewal structure options
